messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] another stan request [iteration number, chain id from program]
parts:
There's already an issue:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/1166

Do you also want to use it to print, like the original
poster (Sean O'Riordain)? There's already some discussion
on the issue, which I'll summarize:

PROBLEM 1: (From Michael) Adding this functionality complicates
the code at the very top call to the log probability function
in a compiled Stan program.

PROBLEM 2: (From me) Not all calls to log_prob are from a
sampler with a well-defined chain ID and iteration number.


And then add:

PROBLEM 3: Branching (if/then-else) on iteration number
can break Markovianness.

PROBLEM 4: Branching on chain ID can cause different
chains to sample from different stationary distributions.

If we did do this, we'd probably want to do it via functions:

int meta_iteration_num();
int meta_chain_id();
int meta_is_warming_up();
int meta_is_sampling();

I'd want to print a warning with any use of such a meta function
at the very least. And probably call it something other than "meta",
which tends to get overused.

- Bob
